data.narrative:
Joby Aviation is a publicly traded company in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of three same-sector peers with comparable valuation profiles: Zipline (Series G, $7.6B), Nuro (Series G, $6.0B), and Archer Aviation (public, $3.3B).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach. The median valuation across the three comparables is $6.0B, with a range spanning $3.3B to $7.6B. This method reflects normalized positioning within the sector peer set at similar funding and development stages. The implied valuation from peer-median analysis is $6.0B.

Synthesizing across available methods, the triangulated valuation range is $5.1B to $6.9B, with a median of $6.0B. Joby's current market valuation of $6.86B falls within the upper end of this range, approximately 14% above the peer median. Key uncertainties include capital intensity and path-to-revenue timelines in autonomous aviation, execution risk on regulatory approvals, and the relatively thin comp universe (three peers) which limits statistical robustness. The company's public status provides greater transparency than its private peers, though the nascent market makes forward multiples difficult to anchor with precision.
